evidence.why: Exact signature, repeated normalization, in-place geometry writes, and model-rotation caller.

facts.rationale: Preserves the valid interface and angular interpretation while correcting the universal finite-input guarantee.
facts.value: Exact signature: void it_80271830(Item* item, f32 angle). The mutable Item supplies four in/out cardinal ECB offsets at xBEC; angle is a model rotation in radians. The function repeatedly adds or subtracts one revolution to normalize the angle before rotation, retaining zero and the upper boundary. This is not a guarantee of accepting every finite magnitude: sufficiently large finite f32 values can fail to change under those operations, and infinities do not terminate.

When present, index selects a runtime HurtCapsule whose a_offset, b_offset, and scale are overwritten from the supplied source. The Koopa-shell caller copies its saved geometry into a temporary and, when requested, assigns a_offset.y = 6.0f and doubles scale before installing it in slot zero; it does not add six to the saved endpoint.
